CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2013 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2013 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 1,428 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 12 benchmark sites in 3 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: March 2013 to May 2013). These surveys captured 11 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 8 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,151 cards across 61 sites, with 1.6% showing evidence of mouse activity (18 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 135 transects across 60 sites (survey period: March 2013 to May 2013), detecting active burrows in 2.2% of transects (total: 4 active burrows).
